question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: transient chat update, footer/status replacement, or only the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: The source-backed gap is clear, but the reporter specifically asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so implementation needs a UX contract before coding the wrong permanent behavior.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary or collapsible chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Show the latest reasoning delta in the footer or activity status line, matching the reporter's follow-up but competing with existing run-state text.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation; update help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking history.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary or collapsible chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent TUI command and lifecycle history and is the strongest routing candidate for a TUI presentation decision.
